name: Full-Tunnel Entire Nitrogen Wave Soldering System

items: Nitrogen Closed-loop Control: Real-time monitoring of nitrogen concentration, PID closed-loop adjust nitrogen flow to achieve a stable PPM value and save nitrogen consumption
Increase Solder Stability: Nitrogen protection improves the wetting of wave infiltration and enhances solder penetration rate to ensure quality stability
Reduce Solder Defect: The tunnel-based entire nitrogen wave soldering can reduce solder defects and improve production efficiency with less oxygen content
Save Cost: The closed preheating environment can reduce power consumption and the production of solder dross
